zepix-tv.description:
ZAPIX: Live TV from Around the World – No Sign-Up Required!

Stream over 2,600 live channels from 31 countries instantly with ZAPIX. Skip the registration and subscriptions—just open the app and watch. Features include:

🌍 Global Access: Browse channels from Asia, Africa, and Europe (including Pakistan, India, and the UK).

🔢 Smart Numbering: Every channel has a number—just type it to zap straight to your show.

🔍 Universal Search: Find any channel or language in seconds.

🌙 Sleep Timer: Fall asleep to your favorite shows with an auto-off timer.

Download ZAPIX now and start watching for free!
